fact: The fiery orange 'eye of the bull' in Taurus — a giant star that only appears to sit among the Hyades cluster.
bio: Aldebaran (Alpha Tauri) is an orange giant about 65 light-years away. It lies in the foreground of the more distant Hyades cluster, a line-of-sight coincidence rather than true membership.
cultural: Aldebaran is one of the four 'Royal Stars' of ancient Persian astronomy. Its name means 'the follower', for the way it trails the Pleiades across the sky.
